summary: Full backend + frontend E2E testing of Hub3 JARVIS v4.2. All 14 pytest cases passed (auth cookie+bearer, dashboard, smart-home CRUD/persistence, chat with Claude Sonnet 4.6, real 3-model consensus). All 4 UI layouts (Dashboard, Consensus, Smart Home, Chat) render with required data-testids; navigation, login (admin), toggle persistence, chat send/inline card, lang-toggle and logout all work.

issues: 'Don't have an account?' label stays in English even when UI switched to PT — minor i18n gap next to the 'Cadastrar' switch link

action_items: (Optional) Translate the 'Don't have an account? / Already have an account?' switch prompt on LoginPage based on selected language.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~450 lines with auth, consensus, dashboard, smart-home and chat mixed — recommend splitting into routers/modules once app grows (>700 lines threshold not yet hit).
CORS_ORIGINS defaults to '*' while cookies are set with samesite='none', secure=True — works because credentials are also passed via Bearer, but production should restrict origins explicitly.
No rate limiting or brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login (auth_testing.md mentions 5-fail lockout requirement) — not enforced.
Consensus/chat rely on external LLM latency (avg ~10-20s); consider timeouts + user-facing loading feedback (frontend appears to handle it).
No input sanitization/length cap on chat.text (only Pydantic default) — consider max_length.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@hub3.ai / Hub3Admin!2026 (seeded on startup). Newly-registered ephemeral test users used for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Registered a random TEST_ user per session for smart-home isolation. Admin seeded by backend automatically.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (pytest, uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL). Consensus test takes ~15-20s. Login endpoint returns token in JSON AND sets httponly cookie — both auth paths tested. Brute-force lockout is NOT implemented (report if added later).
